app.name: chichi
language.label: Language
theme.label: Appearance
idle.noDevice: Plug in USB, or connect wirelessly in Settings → Connection
idle.noApps: Pick your apps in Settings → Apps
idle.ready: Click a row to expand it, then click Open
banner.unauthorized: Your phone is asking to allow USB debugging. Tap Allow.
banner.notConnected: No phone connected. It shows up automatically over USB, or connect wirelessly.
home.emptyText: Pick a few apps from your phone in Settings → Apps and they will show up here.
mirror.name: Whole phone screen
mirror.meta: Mirror, shows exactly what's on the phone
mirror.metaRunning: Open · shows exactly what's on the phone
mirror.alreadyOpen: The phone screen is already open
desktop.name: Extra screen
desktop.meta: An extra phone screen with its secondary home screen; open any app on it
desktop.metaRunning: Open · drag the window to resize
desktop.closed: Extra screen closed; its apps moved back to the phone
desktop.alreadyOpen: The extra screen is already open
desktop.noSecondaryHome: Extra screen opened, but this phone's home app doesn't support secondary screens, so it may stay blank
route.label: Sound on
route.phoneHint: Sound stays on the phone; the computer stays silent.
route.computerHint: While any window is open, all phone sound plays on the computer and the phone is muted. Only one stream, however many windows are open.
route.bothHint: Phone and computer play at the same time. A few apps don't allow their sound to be captured; those only play on the phone.
route.changedBoth: Sound now plays on both phone and computer
app.resizableHint: Drag the window edges and the phone-side screen follows; the app re-lays out for the new size. The size above only sets the starting size.
app.applyNextTime: Size and orientation apply the next time you open it.
app.noDevice: No phone connected. Plug in USB or connect wirelessly first.
app.closedPaused: Closed {name} and paused what it was playing
apps.title: Apps on the phone
apps.hint: Click Add to put an app in your list. Expand it on the Apps tab to change its size or order.
apps.connectFirst: Connect a phone to see its apps here.
apps.addedTitle: Click to remove from your list
size.title: Default window size
size.hint: Used by every app that doesn't have its own size.
size.deviceHint: Reads the phone's current screen size when opening
custom.title: Custom sizes
custom.name: Name
custom.formula: Screen width the app sees = width ÷ (dpi ÷ 160). Phones are usually 360–440.
custom.calc: The app will see a {width} × {height} screen (phones are usually 360–440 wide).
custom.deleted: Deleted {name}; apps using it went back to the default size
input.title: Keyboard and input
input.keyboardUhid: Emulate a hardware keyboard, type with the phone's keyboard app
input.sdkHint: Only plain ASCII characters get through. Text from your computer's input method (Chinese, Japanese, accented letters…) can't be sent. If you need it, copy it on the computer and press Ctrl+V in the window.
input.uhidHint: Keys go to the phone as-is and the phone's keyboard app handles them, so any language works; switch your computer's input method to plain English while typing in a phone window. Side effect: while windows are open the phone thinks a hardware keyboard is attached, so Gboard and others hide the on-screen keyboard when you use the phone directly.
input.keyboardSaved: Keyboard setting saved; applies to windows you open next
phone.title: Phone
phone.wake: Wake the phone automatically when it sleeps
phone.wakeHint: While the phone is locked with its screen off, apps show up in windows but ignore clicks. With this on, the phone is woken before an app opens and whenever you click or type in a window while it sleeps; the click is resent once the phone is awake, so you don't have to click again. Nothing happens while the phone is awake, so using the phone directly isn't affected.
phone.wakeOn: The phone will be woken automatically
phone.wakeOff: The phone will no longer be woken automatically
phone.stay: Bring the app back if Back exits to the home screen
phone.stayHint: Without this, pressing Back repeatedly ends on the phone's secondary home screen (Samsung DeX desktop on Samsung). The app comes back on the same page; it isn't restarted.
phone.stayOn: Apps will be brought back from the home screen
phone.stayOff: Apps will no longer be brought back
advanced.title: Advanced
audio.title: Sound
audio.bufferLargeHint: Least likely to stutter; sound lags the picture by about 0.25 s. Pick this on a shaky network.
audio.bufferMediumHint: Balances smoothness and delay. Fine for most cases.
audio.bufferSmallHint: Lowest delay, but any network hiccup may crackle or cut out. Best over USB.
audio.bufferChanged: Buffer set to {level}; sound that is playing will reconnect
audio.pause: Pause the app if it's playing something
audio.pauseHint: Closing a window doesn't kill the app. Without this, music and podcast apps keep playing in the background.
audio.pauseOn: Playback will pause when you close a window
audio.pauseOff: Playback will no longer pause on close
audio.multiHint: Sound can't be split by window. Luckily, most music, podcast and video apps take turns: when one starts playing, the others pause. That's how Android itself works.
wireless.title: Wireless connection
wireless.knownHint: Phones that have connected wirelessly are remembered here (whoever connected them); just click Connect. If the port has changed, it is found again automatically.
wireless.hint: Nothing to do here if you use USB. For wireless, first turn on Developer options → Wireless debugging on the phone.
wireless.ports: Port (a range or a single port)
tools.title: Program locations
tools.hint: Leave adb / scrcpy as they are to use the copies bundled with the installer (the Windows version includes them), or the ones installed on the system.
tools.scrcpyTooOld: {detail}: too old, 3.0 or newer is required
err.configBroken: The settings file is malformed ({error}). It was renamed to {backup} and default settings are in use.
err.notPinned: This app is no longer in your list. Please refresh.
err.unknownPhone: This phone is no longer in the remembered list; refresh.
err.adbMissing: adb not found ({bin}). Install it with: sudo apt install adb, or enter the full path to adb in Settings.
err.adbTimeout: adb isn't responding. Click Connect in Settings → Connection to restart the adb server.
err.scrcpyMissing: scrcpy not found ({bin}). Download the Linux build from https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy/releases, extract it, and enter the full path to scrcpy in Settings.
err.listAppsTimeout: Timed out reading the app list. Check the phone connection and try again.
err.needAndroid10: Opening single apps needs Android 10 or newer; this phone is API level {sdk}. You can use Whole phone screen above instead.
err.noDisplaySize: Couldn't read the phone's screen size. Try another window size.
err.audioNeed11: Sending sound to the computer needs Android 11 or newer; this phone is API level {sdk}
err.audioNeed13: Playing on both phone and computer needs Android 13 or newer; this phone is API level {sdk}
wl.noHost: Enter the phone's address above first.
wl.badHost: The address contains characters that aren't allowed: {host}
wl.serverDown: The adb server won't start. Make sure adb works in a terminal.
wl.restartFailed: Failed to start the adb server: {detail}
wl.stale: {serial} is listed as connected but the phone doesn't respond; reconnecting
wl.tryLast: Trying the last working port {port} first
wl.lastFailed: The last port no longer works, scanning
wl.badRange: Invalid port: {range}. Use a range like 32768-60999 or a single port number.
wl.scanning: Scanning ports {ports} on {host} with nmap, up to two minutes…
wl.nmapMissing: nmap isn't installed, so ports can't be scanned. Install it with: sudo apt install nmap. Or type the port shown on the phone's Wireless debugging page into Port.
wl.scanTimeout: The nmap scan timed out. Check that the phone and computer can reach each other.
wl.noPorts: No open ports found. Make sure Wireless debugging is on.
wl.unauthorized: The phone hasn't allowed this computer yet. Tap Allow on the phone, then connect again.
app.notInstalledHint: {name} isn't installed on this phone, so it can't be opened. You can remove it.
copy.title: Copy from another phone
copy.hint: Copies that phone's app list and settings to this phone, replacing what this phone has now.
settings.noDevice: No phone connected. Connect one to change these settings.
shot.title: Take a screenshot of {name}
shot.saved: Screenshot saved and copied to the clipboard: {file}
shot.failed: Couldn't take a screenshot of {name}. The window may not be ready yet; try again in a moment.
notify.title: chichi is connected
notify.text: A computer is using this phone. Swipe this notification away to disconnect; apps open on the computer come back to the phone.
device.disconnectedOnPhone: The notification was swiped away on the phone; disconnected “{name}”
